text:
maddie_marketing: Quick pilot idea for the upcoming workshop launch 10: small PLG experiment to raise first-successful-prompt.

maddie_marketing: Plan: 3k credits pool, prompt pack (4 micro-templates), 3 nudges over 7 days, arms = control / credits-only / credits+pack+nudges.

leo_growth: Routing: tag workshop signups with cohort=ignite-pilot and utm_campaign=ignite. enroll first 3k or 30d.

anya_product: Primary KPI = % of cohort that runs prompt.execute(template_id) within 7d. Target = +6pp uplift. Secondary: 7d retention, time-to-first-success.

sam_design: UX: first-login modal with 3 featured templates + one-click Try. include opt-in checkbox: "share anonymized prompt usage to improve templates". mock by EOD. :art:

nina_analytics: Will add experiment_id to events, build dashboard, and run power calc. Suggest allocation 25/37.5/37.5 to give treatments power.

maddie_marketing: Good. follow-ups: if no use in 48h, send soft demo invite + micro-webinar nudge. Manual outreach to top 150 signups.

eng_ops_bot: experiment logged: exp.ignite_5043210001 | cohorts: control/credits/full | alloc: 25/37.5/37.5 | tag=experiment_id=exp.ignite_5043210001

maddie_marketing: Action items: maddie confirm budget (today), sam modal + copy (tomorrow AM), anya follow-up rules (Wed), nina dashboard + SQL (Wed), leo outreach list (Fri). Ping here with blockers. :seedling:
